documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Voting Results Along With Scrutiniser''s Report Of The 44Th Annual General Meeting Held On 18Th September, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Vidya Wires reported strong operational and financial performance for FY26, with operating revenue growing 24.2% year-over-year to 18,396.4 million and EBITDA reaching 857.8 million. The company successfully commenced manufacturing operations at its new subsidiary, ALCU Industries, on February 7, 2026, marking a significant strategic move into value-added specialized products like aluminium paper-covered conductors and continuous transposed conductors (CTC). Management highlighted a robust demand outlook driven by the power, infrastructure, and renewable energy sectors, alongside a disciplined back-to-back hedging strategy that insulates margins from base metal volatility. Vidya Wires Limited reported its financial and business performance for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025, highlighting revenue growth, capacity expansion plans, and a diversified customer base. Management outlined strategies involving capital allocation for debt reduction, scaling up exports, and expanding into renewable energy and EV sectors.

guidance.claim: The management expects the remaining 8,000 to 9,000 tons of capacity to be added by September or October or before Diwali, operating at 100% planned capacity in ALCU.
guidance.quote: remaining 8, 000 to 9,000 tons or so will be added over a period of around September or October or before Diwali we are expecting to operate at 100% capacity planned in ALCU.

guidance.claim: The company expects to be close to 35,000 to 36,000 metric tons of total capacity by Diwali.
guidance.quote: So we will be close to -- by Diwali we will be close to 35,00, 36,000 metric tons of capacity, which was planned.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry research indicates a rebound in India's power demand growth to the 5% to 5.5% range.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry research indicates a rebound in India's power demand growth to 5% to 5.5% range, driven by data centers, industrial consumption and the ongoing energy transition.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for high-quality electrical and industrial winding and conductivity solutions has shifted from a cyclic requirement to a structural necessity.
demand_outlook.quote: As the construction and power sector continue their rapid expansion, the demand for high-quality electrical and industrial winding and conductivity solutions has shifted from a cyclic requirement to a structural necessity.

demand_outlook.claim: India's power generation capacity is expected to more than double from 442 gigawatt in 2024 to approximately 900 gigawatt by 2032.
demand_outlook.quote: Today, the generation capacity is expected to more than double from 442 gigawatt in 2024 to approximately 900 gigawatt by 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: Solar capacity is expected to reach 365 gigawatt by FY2032 growing at a 14.5% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: Solar capacity is expected to reach 365 gigawatt by FY2032 growing at a 14.5% CAGR.

demand_outlook.claim: The wire and cable market is projected to grow from US $17.7 billion to US $27.8 billion by 2028 at a 9.5% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: The wire and cable market is projected to grow from US $17.7 billion to US $27.8 billion by 2028 at a 9.5% CAGR.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing at ALCU Industries commenced on February 7, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: While we have commenced manufacturing on February 7th, 2026, I want to emphasize that we are currently in a phased ramp-up period.

capex_expansion.claim: The company introduced several new specialized product categories including aluminium paper-covered conductors, aluminium enamelled wires and strips, PV round ribbon, multi-paper covered copper conductors, and copper bus bars.
capex_expansion.quote: With this facility now operational, we have successfully introduced several new specialized product categories, which includes aluminium paper-covered conductors, aluminium enamelled wires and strips, PV round ribbon, multi-paper covered copper conductors and copper bus bars.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is nearly doubling its manufacturing capacity from 19,680 metric tons per annum to 37,680 metric tons per annum through a new facility at Narsanda via ALCU Industries.
capex_expansion.quote: We are nearly doubling our manufacturing capacity from 19680 metric tons per annum to 37680 metric tons per annum through our new facility Narsanda via our subsidiary called as ALCU Industries.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new facility has completed more than 75% to 80% and operations will start in the last quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: So we have probably completed more than 75% to 80 % of our construction and we believe in the last quarter, we will start our operations very soon.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA reached 857.8 million with a margin of 4.66%, representing a 35 basis points year-over-year improvement.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA reached 857.8 million with a margin of 4.66, an increase of 35 basis points year-over-year improvement.

margins_costs.claim: The company utilizes a strict back-to-back hedging policy for copper and aluminium procurement to protect margins.
margins_costs.quote: To protect our margins, we have continued our strict back-to-back hedging policy for copper and aluminium procurement.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY2026 EBITDA without other income grew by 19% to Rs. 34 Crores and EBITDA margin increased by 50 basis points to 4.3%.
margins_costs.quote: H1 FY2026 EBITDA without other income grew by 19% to Rs. 34 Crores. The EBITDA margin increased to 4.3% an improvement of 50 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The company has a 100% back-to-back pricing model where increases in LME prices are passed on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Basically, we have a completely back to back pricing model. So about the pricing pass on, it would be 100% whatever price increase in the LME is there will be passed on to the customer.

orders_capacity.claim: Volume-wise the company grew by 6.5% with total volume reaching 18,024 metric tons for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: So by volume-wise our company has grown by 6.5% or so and the revenue growth is around 17% to 18%.

orders_capacity.claim: ALCU Industries contributed approximately 800 metric tons of volume after starting in mid-February.
orders_capacity.quote: So basically, in February mid only, I mean the first week only we have started and we have done some 800 metric tons approximately volume from ALCU Industries.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is on an average around 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, currently our capacity is in like on an average 90% or so we are already utilizing it

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilized INR 100 crores from IPO proceeds to repay working capital borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to a lean balance sheet, we have utilized INR100 crores to repay our working capital borrowings, successfully reducing our interest burden and strengthening our credit profile.

capital_allocation.claim: A significant portion of IPO proceeds was deployed to fund the capital expenditure required for the expansion of ALCU Industries.
capital_allocation.quote: We have deployed a significant portion of IPO proceeds to the fund the capital expenditure required for expansion of ALCU Industries.

capital_allocation.claim: An amount of 1,000 million has been allocated for loan repayment or prepayment to reduce the interest burden.
capital_allocation.quote: ₹1,000 million allocated for loan repayment/prepayment to reduce interest burden.

capital_allocation.claim: Total borrowings stood at 1,627.48 million as of June 30, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Total borrowings stood at ₹1,627.48 million as of June 30, 2025, ₹1,456.29 million (FY25), ₹1,097.11 million (FY24), and ₹971.08 million (FY23)

risks_headwinds.claim: Global logistics and supply chain challenges are present as ocean freights have gone up and vessel availability has been impacted.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, definitely. Nobody will be left aside. So we are also part of this because the ocean freights have gone up, we are not getting many time vessels.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets balancing its geographic mix to 75% domestic and 25% export.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we are definitely targeting the international market and our target is that we should have a balance of 75% domestic and 25% export.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to bring debtor days down to around 35 days in the future.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, we are at 41 days of debtors as of now, and we can definitely bring it down to around 35 days.

management_commitments.claim: The company anticipates operating at 100% of the planned capacity in ALCU before Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: remaining 8, 000 to 9,000 tons or so will be added over a period of around September or October or before Diwali we are expecting to operate at 100% capacity planned in ALCU.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to allocate 1,000 million for loan repayment or prepayment.
management_commitments.quote: ₹1,000 million allocated for loan repayment/prepayment to reduce interest burden.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims for export revenue to reach the range of 22% to 25% in the coming time.
management_commitments.quote: With the new expansion and all, we are looking that we should be in the coming time approximately, we should be able to in the range of 22% to 25% of export market.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets utilization of the new capacity at around 55% to 60% next year.
management_commitments.quote: So, the next year we see that new capacity will come up and we are looking around 55% to 60% of that capacity should be able to utilize.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
